title: Sprint 20 · Test guide
goal: Customers can see and download their invoices without contacting support.

features.title: Invoice history
features.whats_new: Customers can now see all their invoices in one place, the most recent first, and filter them by year.
features.why: Customers no longer need to email support to find an old invoice.
before: Sign in as the customer "Acme Ltd" (user acme@example.com, password in the team vault).
Acme Ltd has 3 invoices: July, August and September 2026.

scenarios.title: See your invoices
scenarios.expected: You see 3 invoices, with September 2026 at the top.

scenarios.title: Filter by year
steps: Choose the year 2025 in the Year filter.
scenarios.expected: You see the message "No invoices for 2025".

scenarios.title: Only your own invoices
scenarios.expected: You see only Globex's single invoice, never Acme's.

scenarios.title: Signed out
scenarios.expected: You are asked to sign in, and no invoices are shown.

not_included: Downloading an invoice as a PDF comes in the next sprint.
known_issues: The Year filter shows years with no invoices.

features.title: Invoice reminders
features.whats_new: Customers get an email 3 days before an invoice is due.
before: Use the test mailbox at https://mail.staging.example.com (shared login in the team vault).

scenarios.title: Reminder arrives
steps: Ask the team to create an invoice for Acme Ltd due in 3 days.
Wait up to 10 minutes and open the test mailbox.
scenarios.expected: An email "Your invoice is due in 3 days" arrives, with the amount and a Pay now button.

verified_automatically: Invoice data service used by the Billing page
